text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew! That's my extra sprint done!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm? Over there—could that be…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Phew.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Great work, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kita. I didn't realize you were still here as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yep! I just got in an extra sprint, and now I'm about to head outside!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is that so? You're working very hard.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's because I want to be just like Teio! And all I can do right now is put in my best effort!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll let you get back to it. Later!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Psshhh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Your legs are beautiful. Those are the legs of an exceptional runner.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much! Um, I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But I expect those legs are the very reason you fail to realize you're overworking yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There, I've finished with the cooling spray on your legs. Make sure to massage them thoroughly in the future.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: R-right. But why are you…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Because I know very well how it feels to want to catch up to Teio.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, you can't allow yourself to become so fixated on her that you miss the changes occurring within you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let's both try to be more vigilant. Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: McQueen really is amazing…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She's Teio's rival after all, though. It's no wonder she's so impressive! All right! I need to work hard too!
